newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Bovespa sees 259.3 mln reais inflows in May.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Bovespa sees 259.3 mln reais inflows in May.

text.p: Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it has registered net foreign capital inflows of 259.3 million reais in May.
Foreign buys totalled 3.944 billion reais, while foreign sales amounted to 3.685 billion reais in the period, it said in a statement.
In 1997's first five months, net foreign investment in the bolsa totalled 1.426 billion reais, it said.
